findings.title: After a top-level kill of the test run, the in-flight race case can fail with "the toggler ran: expected 0 to be greater than 50" instead of the designed "the test run was killed" message.
findings.evidence: ts/vite.config.test.ts:674-676; the toggler exits on its own ancestor check while the loop waits in Promise.all. Reproduced by kill -9 of npm exec mid race. Cleanup itself held.
findings.consequence: A killed run reads like a security regression, misdirecting whoever debugs it.

findings.title: The ?html-proxy exception in load() is untested.
findings.evidence: ts/vite.config.ts:474-490; no html-proxy case in ts/vite.config.test.ts.
findings.consequence: A regression on that path would go unnoticed.
